The '''Geska Prime system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Lifh sector/Legends|Lifh sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Geska Prime]].
